horizontal lines of incised text below lunette
registers separated by horizontal dividing lines

justification: Both surfaces show the identical scheme: a round-topped stela with a winged disc in the lunette, two lines of horizontal text, then an upper register of seated figures before an offering table faced by attendants, and two lower registers of kneeling/seated adorants with interspersed sign columns — down to the same postures and the same positions of each figure. These appear to be the same monument (or a cast/copy of it); no substantive difference in depicted content is visible, only surface tone and lighting.
